defect: DepthStep throws only when the depth is greater than the maximum (>) instead of when it reaches it (>=), so MaximumObjectGraphDepth + 1 levels of nesting are accepted.
why: An off-by-one in the limit on object graph depth for untrusted input: the configured maximum is exceeded by one level before the exception is thrown.
